title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
**Experience:** 4+ years (3+ years with an advanced degree)

**Only candidates from Tier 1 institutes are eligible to apply.**

**Mandatory Skills**: Python / TypeScript / Java, Playwright / Cypress / Selenium, API testing (RestAssured / Postman / Newman), CI/CD test gating, automation framework design

**Role Summary**

Build and own the automation framework and regression suite that decides whether a release reaches production, with real authority to stop a deployment. This is an engineering role, not manual testing with some Selenium attached: you join the design conversation and test for logical failures, not just visual ones.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Framework: API and UI automation built as a codebase with the same standards as the product.

* Regression suite: Fast enough that people run it and trustworthy enough that a red build means something.

* Release gating: Define and enforce pre-production validation and criteria for going to production.

* Contract and integration tests: Across services and across the boundary with connected organisations.

* Quality signal: Defect triage, coverage and escape metrics that leadership can act on.

* Testing blind: Design test data, fixtures and failure diagnosis that work without reading personal data payloads.

* Proving a negative: Test that an append-only, tamper-evident consent ledger cannot be quietly subverted.

* Withdrawal propagation: Verify across a distributed system, including failure paths, that a withdrawal reaches every connected organisation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 4 years building test automation as software, or 3 years with an advanced degree, or equivalent practical experience.

* Has designed an automation framework from scratch, not only written tests inside someone else’s.

* Strong programming in Python, TypeScript or Java.

* Playwright, Cypress or Selenium at depth, and API testing with RestAssured, Postman/Newman or equivalent.

* Tests wired into CI as a gate that can genuinely block a release.

* Test design as a discipline: risk-based coverage, boundary and negative cases, and judgement on what not to automate.

* Hands-on use of AI-assisted testing tools for authoring, maintenance or coverage analysis.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Contract testing between services (Pact or equivalent).

* Performance and load testing with JMeter, k6 or Locust.

* Security testing fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, authentication and authorisation edge cases, injection paths.

* Mobile test automation, ideally Flutter.

* ISTQB certification.

Pay: ₹900,000.00 - ₹1,400,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of professional experience do you have in test automation?
* Have you designed an automation framework from scratch (not only written tests in an existing one)?
* Which programming languages have you used for test automation?
* Which automation and API testing tools have you used at depth?
* Describe how your automated tests are wired into CI and how they block a release when they fail

Work Location: In person

title: Substation Automation Engineer
description:
As a Substation Automation Engineer, you will support the technical delivery of digital control and protection systems for complex HVDC projects. Operating across New Product Introduction (NPI), requisition (ITO/OTR), and Product Care, you will combine hands-on engineering execution—such as IEC 61850 configuration, schematic design, and system testing—with continuous learning and collaboration alongside senior technical experts to meet project cost, schedule, and quality targets.

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Design, Implementation and Integration**

* Support project designs and delivery in alignment with customer specifications, internal reference solutions, and senior engineer guidance.

* Assist in the preparation of base and detailed design documents for HVDC Control and Protection systems, including communication architecture descriptions, HMI Functional Design Specifications (FDS), test specifications, I/O lists, and switchgear interlocking specifications.

* Prepare IED configurations for Bay Control Units (BCU) and Merging Units (MU) based on approved I/O lists.

* Configure IEC 61850-based systems (GOOSE, SV, MMS) utilizing vendor-specific tools and System Configuration Tools to generate Substation Configuration Description Language (SCL) files.

* Assist in preparing HMI and Communication Gateway database configurations based on I/O lists.

* Support the integration of IEDs, HMIs, and Gateways during Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT).

* Assist in preparing Fibre Optic Cable schedules (interconnection diagrams) based on communication architecture and panel layouts.

* Produce control panel and cabinet manufacturing documentation using standard design tools (e.g., Engineering Base):

o Panel General Assembly (GA) drawings, Cabinet Design, and Electrical Schematics.

o Interconnection Diagrams and Cable Schedules.

o Bills of Materials (BOM) and Routine Test specifications.

* Verify electrical and physical interfaces between HVDC Control and Protection cabinets and primary equipment (e.g., Circuit Breakers, Disconnectors, Earth Switches, and Instrument Transformers [CT/VT/CVT]) under the direction of senior engineers.

  

**2. Testing and Debugging**

  

* Assist with systematic root-cause analysis and debugging for electrical circuits, auxiliary power systems, control panels, and automation hardware during manufacturing and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT).

* Troubleshoot IEC 61850 communication streams, sampled values (SV), and Layer 2/3 substation network switches using industry-standard tools (e.g., Wireshark, IED Scout) with guidance from senior staff.

* Support FAT execution, help coordinate control system integration with Balance of Plant (BoP) and SCADA/HMI platforms, and work closely with assembly and QA teams during cabinet wiring and integration.

  

**3. Continuous Improvement & Collaboration**

* Actively participate in technical training, skill development, and knowledge-sharing initiatives within the department.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (project management, primary design, quality) to ensure design quality and support delivery targets.

* Review design documents under the mentorship of senior engineers, contributing fresh perspectives to continuous improvement initiatives.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, or a related field.

* **4-8 years** of professional experience in IEC 61850-based substation control and protection system design, integration, testing, or commissioning.

* Foundational hands-on debugging and troubleshooting experience across hardware, wiring, measurement circuits, and IEC 61850 communication protocols (GOOSE, SV, MMS).

* Familiarity with electrical schematic design, cabinet engineering, interconnection engineering, and C&P relay logic development.

* Basic technical understanding of substation measurement circuits, hardware signal mapping, and tripping/interlocking schemes.

  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity best practices.

* Strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills with a willingness to learn in a complex system engineering environment.

* Demonstrated ability to take direction, solve routine engineering problems, and work effectively within a multidisciplinary team.

* A detail-oriented mindset focused on producing quality designs that meet performance and reliability targets.

  

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Senior SDET

* Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

**Good to Have:**

With over 15 years of proven expertise, we have partnered with **Fortune 500 companies and leading global brands** to drive digital innovation and deliver excellence.
